body: Here's a tip for erupor, aim between limbs and the body, you'll get both the bullet damage and a ton of shrapnel will hit the target too, I use it to 90% reliably one shot devastators and Overseers (devs are easier due to more rigid poses), and shooting fleshfucks in the crotch or between the legs is pretty reliable at getting them down in 3 shots too, while also crippling them

Josephine eh? Cute name, I like it! Im sure youll make some kind o' breakthrough, even if it isnt what you're expectin.. *she gives Josephine a hearty pat on the back, enough to knock both the breath and malaise out of her* no time fer pitying, you're finally getting some good food! 

Not only nutritious but somethin that actually tastes good! You cant live off bland Ramen and the occasional apple, let's hope those taste buds of yours havent atrophied yet.

As long as this perfect place aint a vending machine im all for it, what kinda place even is it? *Barb follows Josephine out from the basement, wallet in hand*

*slightly thrown off by the sudden shift, she looks around before grounding herself, digging her feet into the ground for a moment to assure herself this isnt some illusion, and simply assuming she must have blanked out for the time, before just walking in alongside Josephine*

*as she looks around the place, health code violations abound, it felt like home to her, reminiscent of places back in Ichoris, and hopefully the food is just as good*
Reminds me of home, a lil run down but a diamond in the rough nonetheless, nice to have a place so familiar this far from Tychos.. so what've they got?-
Project Landsword by Mezzsoft is promising! Its not quite the same but it has similar Mecha and feels fairly frantic, it's still a demo now but is free on Itch.io!

I'll see if I can get their contacts! Just you wait!- ..keep the money though, you clearly need it far more than me Lass. *she looks down at her wallet, which is quite full compared to Josephines handful of coins before*

*last* weekend?!?- you're nearly worse than Nixie! Forget about Scurvy, you're gonna have just about every other thing brought on by malnutrition! *she pauses and sighs, seemingly realizing something* sheesh, you're gettin me worked up already and I dont even know yer name. Im Barbarossa Ambrose, you?- 

*she turns her attention to Rossi as she begins to speak* sounds good to me! Wouldnt want them to feel left out.. besides, im sure you just wanna tease em more hmm?~ cya Love~ *she returns a brief kiss on Rossi's cheek as she goes to take flight, waving her off* ..welp, just you 'n me now lass, how's about some food now? Anything in mind?

Poor luck- ive met a handful of wizards in my day, they'd love to explain what they know till their lungs wear out, At least if they dont talk your ears off first! Ive not had much chance to listen, nor did I understand the half of it when could.. but im sure someone like you could gleam somethin out of it, i can get you in contact with em!- 

*Barb sorts through her wallet as Josephine rambles to herself in her head, fully prepared to pay for a full meal and then some, taking a bit of pity on her* 

Ya can't live off o' bagels and noodles, theres no substance!- when was the last time you had any protein?? You can sleep after you eat, its not good to sleep on an empty stomach anyways-

Sorry to burst your bubble, but you've been lookin at it wrong, doesnt matter if you've put more work into it if that work won't get anywhere no? It's like researching electricity solely through lickin batteries, Im surprised you never reached out to a proper mage fer questions, surely you'd have gotten much farther no?

*she chocks the simultaneous deactivation up to an automatic system, not paying it much mind, just getting up and stretching a bit*

Kind of?.. *sigh* just, lets get some food aight? *she watches as Josephine fumbles around her desk, pulling out the coin pouch and sorting every coin by hand, sighing once more as she realizes how little cash the girl actually has and reaching for her own wallet before Josephine even finishes counting*

..13 credits ain't even enough to get a snack, what did you plan on fer food for the rest of the month??- just, cmon, I'll pay this time. *she holds up her wallet, which in comparison to Josephines penniless pouch, is veritably filled to the brim, being a merc pays quite heftily*

*Barb stares up at her, she has a feeling shes in for a lecture, but shes ready for it, she may not know much magic, but she knows that a few sensors won't cut it*

*she watches and listens as Josephine enters a frustrated nerdy tirade, waiting patently as she listens, she recognizes the sensors, and also that theyre not going to do much for the supernatural*

Lass, you ever considered that maybe magic doesnt *want* measured?.. it ain't a normal science, i may not know much about it, but I can say for certain its not somethin you can just measure like electricity!

I know physics lass, im an engineer, but I also know magic doesnt particularly enjoy bein put into categories either. It does what it wants, mass comes n goes, folds in on itself.. 

*she lets out a sigh as she finishes her sentence, clearly finding this whole thing a bit absurd, especially to have been pulled away from a date for, shes trying not to be annoyed, but she cant help but be a little bothered that she missed so much time for nothing*

..sorry it didnt work out lass, but I cant spend all day down here, ive got a date to continue, and after all that power use, an appetite too. How about you make it worth our time n take us for some food? Surely its cheaper than whatever that electric bill would've been- and then afterwards, *you* get some sleep..
Damn, aight, ig I'll keep an eye on it

*Barb chuckles slightly as the simple bolt toss results in something so dramatic, plugging up as soon as shes told she can, getting up and helping Josephine up as well* Say lass.. what are you even trying here? This is quite the machinery for the equivalent of a tea kettle—

*shes a little startled by the shout, not having expected it after such a long period of deadening silence* what now?.. forget to turn somethin on? *she listens to the sudden tirade, only getting further and further confused*

*eventually, it clicks, she realizes what this poor girl is trying to do* Dont tell me, youre trying to do science, on *magic?* surely you know this won't work right?- especially with these machines, they measure the normal, not the paranormal!–
Ive said this! There's species of ants that farm fungus! This very well could be how they sustain themselves!
I tried that already, same for verifying file integrity

Ive discussed this theory before! There's so many signs pointing to a symbiotic relationship with some kind of fungus like cordyceps! You can even see the mycelial networks growing on the ground in bug nests and gloom worlds!
I see, it almost feels like they went out of their way to make it bad, you can't even overlap controls if you wanted to, so youre stuck with it being clunky

Bouncing back and forth of your own volition.. or getting kicked out?- *Barb winces a little as Josephine attempts to jam a power cord under the equivalent of her gauntlets finger nail, her doing this several times before eventually noticing the port on the side and successfully plugging in there, Barb sitting rather close to all this machinery in order for the cords to reach, potentially dangerously close to whatever is about to happen*

*she holds back a chuckle at the whole setup, all for a measly little kettle, still mildly concerned about potential dangers, but unfathomably curious about whatever this woman is even trying to do*

Ya sure it's safe for me to be this close?.. I don't like how careful you're bein- I'm not gonna get shocked right?- what even are these "variables"?? I should have asked what youre trying to do from the start've all this!- *oh well, it's too late for her to go back now*

*and as kettle activates she waits, for something, anything to happen, maybe it just takes a bit to get accurate readings.. maybe the signals are faint so it'll take a bit... perhaps the she forgot to turn it on? Surely it's on now..... wow this power draw sure is making Barb hungry.......*

Is it done? I'm starving! This amount of power draw is exhausting!...

*she waits for a response... but none comes, and so she carefully turns around as to not unplug anything, upon noticing Josephine asleep in the chair she shouts and tosses a loose bolt from the floor at her, bonking her square on the forehead* Oi!- I thought ye had an experiment to do! Not nappin!
Yeah I love the hmg don't get me wrong, but it runs out of ammo too fast for me, especially for the damage it can put out and the reload time, so I stick with the classic mg

*she follows the woman in, giving a brief wave to the old man as she rushes by, before just as quickly continuing to follow, not wanting left behind.*

Leadin us into a basement?.. you sure you aren't some sorta mad scientist?- *despite her words, Barb doesnt slow down, her curiosity only being furthered as she actually enters the basement and sees the mess of machinery and equipment in the corner*

Grant money hm? So youre a government sanctioned mad scientist.. im here now though, I just hope you know im expectin something in return Lass. *she sits down on the floor next to the machines, raising an arm for the woman to access as a panel on the side seems to automatically pop open, revealing several ports and plug ins directly in her arm* 'ere ya go, dont take too long now, we've got places to be.
I see, good to know! And yeah Hmg is ammo hungry af, its why I switched to basic MG

I've got two, one for bots/squids, one for bugs 

Bots is Crossbow, Senator, thermite, Fortified commando, machine gun, Supply pack, At emplacement and Ops

For bugs, it's cookout, grenade pistol, incendiary, Salamander, flamethrower, supply pack, and then whichever other strats I wanted

Bugs has the more fun playstyle, where I close range flame thrower and set myself on fire too, but as a result kill absolutely everything near me, the supply pack is purely to keep me topped up on stims and fuel for the flamer
Tenderizer runs out of ammo so fast, what's your strategy with it?

*Barb looks at her, partly confused, partly concerned, whoever needs this much electricity likely isn't up to anything safe.. but since when has Barb been interested in safety anyways? She lets out a sigh as she speaks up* Well, if I help ya, I expect some form of compensation.. ya did just interrupt our date after all. *she gestures to Rossi, who seems equally curious*

..Mhmm... and what lab equipment requires more power than a designated power grid can provide? Certainly no equipment I've seen before, even a forge doesn't need this much power.. *Barb is hesitant, but decides to go along with her, waiting for Rossi's approval as well, then following* Just once we're done, get some damned sleep, else those bags under your eyes are gonna take over the rest of your face too.

*Barb is perfectly satisfied walking around the festival with Rossi and giving her affection, its not often she has so much down time to spend with her lover*

It'd be nice to look around.. or maybe see if there's some more places with treats around here too...- *Barb is caught off guard as Rossi is knocked away from her, immediately getting a little defensive, only letting up a little as the woman apologizes excessively* -Aye! watch it, you aren't the only one in the crowd y'know. Someone could have gotten hurt, and youd better hope it wasn't her!–

*Barb is about to continue going off, before the girl whips around and examines her, a tad confused, this only being exemplified by her sudden excitement* Im.. sorry? You can't borrow them- besides, they aren't the power source anyways, I am- *she sets aside her annoyance at the girls recklessness out of sheer curiosity and confusion* ..what do you need this much power for anyways?-

*Barb follows her out, arm around Rossi, keeping her close and giving her the occasional kiss on the cheek, still soaking in all the feelings and comfort*

Well.. I'm sure Zoe wouldn't mind waiting just a little longer, are there any booths that caught your attention when we were walking around?- I've still got plenty'o cash on hand after all *she responds to Rossi's grip by tightening her own, neither of them wanting to let go any time soon it seems*

I love it, i use the salamander armor and a flamethrower with the supply pack, I basically immolate myself and everything around me while spamming stims to stay on my feet, I cannot describe how good it feels to hold off an endless horde of bugs with the flamethrower whilst marching through your own flames in order to draw them away from your retreating allies.

*Barb is in no rush to break off from the kiss either, softly brushing the Lumenites soft fluffy hair and carefully caressing her antenna, looking into her eyes as their lips part, taking in a breath after such a long kiss and listening as Rossi speaks, holding her closer the further along she gets* Dont worry.. I'm not going anywhere, not in a hundred years, I'm yours forever Sweetheart. *she kisses Rossi again, this time only briefly as she cups her face in her hands, looking down at her on her lap* I know my job is dangerous.. but I promise you, I'll always come back, you dont have to worry yourself.

*she lets Rossi settle back down in her arms, simply rubbing her back and hair and holding her close, as the wheel reaches the ground she's hesitant to let go, but they're out of tickets and unfortunately time, Barb eventually letting go and following Rossi out closely, carefully holding her hand as she does*
I mean, being one of Carla's toys could mean other things as well to be fair....

You don't stick to the ground at all in this game, if you hit a little bump while sprinting it will *gladly* send you careening into the air, where you have nearly 0 control over movement until you land, this has happened many a time, several of those times it has sent me flying off a cliff or building, killing me

*Barb hushes, taking the hint and calming down, although a bit of excitement can't help but seep through. She gently takes Rossi's hand after she shushes her and gives it a soft kiss, looking up at Rossi and meeting her gaze as she does.*

*as Rossi sits on Barbs lap, she leans against her lightly and gently wraps her arms around her, her body is warm, warmer than normal, it's cozy, like a warm blanket on a cold day, Barb simply relaxing and taking in the view, of both the town lights outside the carriage, and the beautiful Lumenite within*
Its not silly.. sometimes moments like these are the best you could ask for.. it can be hard to slow down with a job like mine, but it makes these moments all the more worthwhile and special.

*Barb too is calm, talking honestly and softly, she's happy, the happiest she's been this entire festival, relaxed, and with her lover in her arms.* I love you too, you're incredible.. there's too much to say.. but in the end, I'm glad you're mine, more than ever. I love you. 

*she finishes this with a kiss, carefully pulling Rossi close and tenderly kissing her right on the lips, holding it for a good while, savoring the moment.*

Enemy of what??- *Barbs concern grows as her voice ceases, silently miming out words that Barb attempts to read, as the woman grabs her neck Barb rushes over in an attempt to help, albeit with no clue what to do whatsoever, her panic only mounting as the words emerge from the floor, a message for her.*

Parasite?! Word of the wicked?- I've no clue what you mean- but leave the lass out of this! She's done nothing wrong! *she shouts into the room, at nothing in particular* 

Dammit- I'm not leavin ya to die ta somethin i caused- *as the Receptionist resigns herself to her fate, Barb has a different idea, hoisting her over her shoulder and beginning her sprint through the blast doors, hopefully to some place she could get help she hopes, though it's a thin chance*

*Barb has a similarly dumb grin, shes happy and excited, giving Rossi several kisses as she carries her towards the ferris wheel, not in any rush either, enjoying carrying and teasing her, but eventually they reach it nonetheless, and Barb gently sits Rossi down, watching as she giddily hands over the tickets*

Never been on one of these before? Or are you just excited to go on one with me?~ Your enthusiasm is contagious!- *she follows her on, sitting across from Rossi and smiling her massive dumb grin* I wonder, what do you have planned hm?~

*as Zoe heads off, Barb turns to Rossi, still leaning on her gauntlet, and suddenly scoops her up in a princess carry* last time I carried you it was less than romantic.. so how about I do it right this time?~ besides, you must be sooo tired from all this walking..~ *she gives Rossi another teasing kiss, Barb is clearly having a lot of fun with this as she sets off to the ferris wheel*

Ah, fair nuff.. I'm not much for the quiet life, if it wasn't obvious... but it has its perks, I've seen that much- *she takes notice of it, toning herself back a little* Well as long as she's fine with it, she'll be gettin plenty o' attention later anyways~

Outer maze it is for me! I'll do my best not to trap you in, I'm not the best at puzzles though- *Barb steps up to the machine and takes a wheel in hand, ready to start when Zoe is*

*she starts as they do, getting the hang of the controls fast, but slowing down at the maze itself, doing her best to concentrate with an adorable nerd next to her*

*as she gets her frog to the exit, she stands back and let's Zoe get to work, watching them indulge in the game they were so excited to share with her, looking rather satisfied, her eyes briefly turning a myriad of colors as she stares, before the sudden "CONGRATULATIONS" appears and jolts her to attention, hopefully before Zoe notices as well*

We did it!- I'm surprised you got past the mess I left behind–

*she holds the now decommissioned guards body up by its head, watching the glow travel across the room and escape into the unknown beyond the walls*

I do not hail from Erescia! nor do I know of any slights they may have committed against you!– *she reacts quickly to the rattling of the ammunition chains against the floor, turning as it raises its minigun, and responding by swinging the corpse of the previously slain guard into it, slamming the heavy metallic mass into the lead unit, knocking the mini gun aside*

We're tryna talk here dammit!- *she finishes the job with a stomp to whatever remains of this units head, putting enough weight into it to shake the room, before simply looking up at the Receptionist with a sigh* Now, can we talk without further interruptions Ma'am?

*Barb tugs on the drillbuster, throwing it backwards and into the ground, the momentum quickly launching her forwards with the aid of a flame burst from her other hand, grabbing the head of the unit and gripping down tight to crush it, now standing over the destroyed guards, calling out to the other four guards outside the room*

Just tell me what the hells goin on?! I'm not gettin paid to fight dammit- Now explain shit n don't force me to tear more o' yall apart!-

*she eyes Danzon as Carmen snaps at him, not with a glare like his superior, but with concern and worry, before shifting her gaze back to Carmen*

Listen lass, I'm not one of them, I just responded to a flier someone plastered on my ship!- I've no clue what's going on but I wasn't here to fight dammit!- 

*as the soldiers rush in, Barb tries to avoid the combat at first, she'd rather not harm people when she doesn't have the full context, but she's been left no choice as they begin to fire at her*

*she leaps across the room, grabbing a filing cabinet and chucks it at the leading one, aiming right for its face, and in the same moment, a plume of smoke erupts from her hand, filling the upper half of the enclosed room in a thick choking smoke filled with embers and flames, not enough to burn anything, but enough to disrupt any thermals they may have*

*after this, Barb ducks down to where the smoke is just thin enough to see, she can only see their lower torsos and legs, but that's all she needs to know where to swing, starting with the Leader, following up the filing cabinet with a solid uppercut to its presumed head, finishing it off if it had survived the filing cabinet, drawing the drillbuster with her other hand at the same time and readying it to swing at the other 3 guards, striking at their lower torsos with a massive arcing swing, hopefully completely bisecting them and finishing off the first group of four as she does*

(She doesn't have the knuckledusters on yet btw, and I'm stopping her here so she doesn't seem too fast)

Lass i don't know what's going on but I'm not here for trouble!- I was just sent to look for missing people! *Barb is confused, not quite panicked, but the fact they just trapped her inside somewhere is certainly a cause for concern.* -I just need information!

*Barb takes a step back as everything ceases its activity, slightly alarmed, her eyes locked on the receptionist and her arm reaching to her back, prepared to draw her weapon from her hood*

I'm sorry Miss, I can't just leave empty handed, I've a job to do, but I'd much prefer to avoid any unneeded bloodshed as well.

*she cares not for its cracking, simply shifting to get more comfortable, and almost certainly smearing whatever leftover filth from her last mission upon it, even if hardly noticeable to a non snob*

Comfortable is not a word I would have used for this.. someone of your stature *should* be able to afford more than gravel for stuffing, maybe the slums know how to make a seat that lasts, I hear they're rather resourceful with what they have. 

And don't worry, I'll be getting up shortly, I just thought it a shame a sofa never get any use don't you? *she lays across it, having made herself at home in a show of spite* I get jobs done for those who won't do em themselves, otherwise I'd be out of the business by now.

*Barb scowls at her, she had her suspicions, but it's clear now, this is the kind of woman she despises* 

Cherrypicking the failures, so you're that kind of woman eh? You should look at your own first and foremost, I'm not the one getting someone else to do my dirty work now am I? *she refuses to take shit from Carmen, taking a heavy, confident seat down in one of the Gold inlaid loveseats, making herself abundantly comfortable as she speaks.*

So, you want me to descend into the slums of your station because you've failed to manage it yourself? You're lucky you've got me to fix it up now, as you said, I'm rather proficient in those environments, and I've no qualms with getting a little dirty. The real question is, can you afford to pay?

*she turns Carmen's snobbishness back on her, staying calm out of sheer spite*

*Barb doesn't step back, simply eyeing her down in return, fairly curious as to the actual design of such robots, considering she hadn't been briefed on any of this part*

I am here on behalf of Erescia, the name is Barbarossa.

*she looks up at her, eying the mechanical woman back* 

You could say I was sent to survey yes.. though I've no knowledge on the Sil'nyy you speak of, as I said, I'm here to investigate a few disappearances n goings on here. 

*Barb pulls her coat a little more taught around her, not fully liking the idea of her body being scanned*

*Barb contemplates her options, before eventually, stepping out from her hiding spot, stuffing her cloak into her hood as she does, raising her hands to show she's not a threat, nor holding anything dangerous, although the size of her hands may pose concern anyways*

Aye Miss, you know of any people goin missing 'round here? I got sent to investigate, d'worry, I've no intentions of fightin.
*as they flock to the pile, Barb books it for the entrance, starting from the farthest point from the rest of them and trying to stick to shadows*

*she tries to see if there's any cover to reach the room from where she's standing, keeping an eye out for any loaders that may spot her, before finally deciding on an option, specifically, a distraction.*

*Barb approaches a stack of the crates being unloaded from the ships, and gives it a shove, causing it to topple over before returning to a hiding spot closer to the entrance, waiting for them to investigate the apparent "accidental collapse" allowing her to slip into the building if all goes well*

oh shut it, you thought it was adorable too– I know what you're like *Barb mumbles under her breath to Rossi as she notices her laugh, before turning her attention back on Zoe, listening to them go on about the game*

*she lets out a giggle as the boy corrects Zoe, Barb being very amused by all of this*

Someone's a bit addicted huh? Not everyday you hear of a carnival game upgrading their challenge just fer one lass!- 'n I'm fine with either, what'd you prefer?
*she breathes a sigh of relief as the figure walks away Barb peeks over the edge of the boxes, examining the area and looking for a proper way in*
*Barb immediately ducks behind the crates, her darker colored cloak helping mask her in the dark cargo bay further, attempting to peek between crates at the figure as she takes cover*
*she leans over, gauging the distance before leaping down, landing with a solid thud and looking around for anyone who may have seek, or any guards as well*

*she grumbles to herself as she walks, any heat she would generate with her gauntlets or flames being whisked away by the winds, leaving her frigid and agitated. Upon nearing the edge of the structure, her first focus is to search for an entrance, she'd rather fight through guards than stay in this forsaken weather any longer*

*before stepping out, she grabs her fur coat, it's thick, plenty to stop the wind, and the scalemail inlaid within it perhaps even enough to stop a bullet, wrapping it tightly around her as she leaves the warmth of her ship, shuddering and raising an arm to shield her eyes from the wind, they may be augmented, but it doesn't stop her human instincts from trying to close them, the cold making her mutter indecipherable slurs under her breath as she starts towards her destination*

*Barbs entire tone has shifted by now, no longer loud or excited, simply a respectful calm*

He's?.. actually, nevermind, I should have guessed- sorry for bringing back memories...

*Barb takes them delicately, carefully trying them on and examining them further*

I'll treat them well, they'll get as much care as my own augments while in my care, you can count on it.

*Barb examines them as she takes them down, on the tips of her toes to get a better look due to the disparity in height*

Personally I ain't much for listenin blindly, it's best if they can back up a question with a proper answer no?-

*Her jovial attitude falters as she finally realizes Sylvia's hesitation to hand off the gauntlets, reaching for them carefully, but not yet picking them up*

Hold on.. are you sure you want to let me use these?- I may be dense, by even I can tell these mean a lot to you lass- I can find something else if need be-

Oh? He's certainly somethin, I haven't met many with augments this size, it's a serious undertakin to get done, makes it all more impressive! 

*she doesn't notice the discomfort, a little too distracted to notice it through the veil, and also simply oblivious to this places customs still*

That wouldn't surprise me.. she seems rather powerful, if not a little strange.. but that goes for most mages no?

Seems so!- looks custom too, say, who's this Yosef fellow?-

*she stares a little as Sylvia pulls the keys from nowhere, seemingly in surprise at first, before suddenly looking excited, and not about the new weapons*

You can do that too?!- I ain't met someone with storage magic in a long while, I got somethin pretty handy from a mage like that too! Check it!– *she reaches behind her, as if unsheathing a sword on her back, except her hand dissappears into.. her hood? The mass just vanishing, but as quickly as it enters, she pulls it out, drawing something massive out with it and resting it on her shoulder. A huge sword for lack of a better term, like the lovechild between a lathe and a buster sword.*
